info.name: VDP Purchase Cards
info.description: Postman collection for testing VDP API responses that drive the 5 purchase card states: Generic, Estimate, Offer Received, Offer Expired, and Sold.

request.description:
Default purchase card state — no payment/offer data.

Card shows:
- "Below market" badge (from `data.vehicle.belowMarket`)
- Selling price $30,775 (from `data.vehicle.pricing.sellingPrice`)
- List price $31,775 strikethrough (from `data.vehicle.pricing.listPrice`)
- "TOYOTA HIGHLANDER HYBRID LIMITED" (from `vehicleInfo.make`, `vehicleInfo.model`, `vehicleInfo.trim`)
- "2023 · 36,435 mi" (from `vehicleInfo.year`, `status.mileage`)
- "Get pre-approved" button
- Dealer: "Toyota of Bay Ridge, 6401 6th Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11220" (from `data.dealer`)
- Test drive slots (from `data.dealer.extended.testDrive` — not part of VIN API, enriched by BFF)

Estimate state — visitor has started a payment estimate but no formal offer yet.

Card shows everything from Generic PLUS:
- "Estimated payment $456.97/mo" (from `data.origination.estimatedMonthly`)
- "with $3,500 down" (from `data.origination.downPayment`)
- "Get pre-approved" button
- Test drive note: "You have a test drive at Toyota of Manhattan today at 2:30 PM" (visitor-specific, from booking service)

Active offer state — visitor has a pre-approved financing offer.

Card shows everything from Generic PLUS:
- "Your offer: Expires in 5d, 18h" (countdown derived from `data.origination.expiresAt`)
- "$297/mo" (from `data.origination.monthly`)
- "3.25% APR for 60 months" (from `data.origination.apr`, `data.origination.termMonths`)
- "Continue purchase" button (instead of "Get pre-approved")

Expired offer state — visitor had an offer that is no longer valid.

Card shows everything from Generic PLUS:
- "Your previous offer has expired." (triggered when `data.origination.kind === "expired"`)
- "Restart purchase" button (instead of "Get pre-approved")

Sold state — vehicle is no longer available.

Card shows a completely different layout:
- "Vehicle sold" badge (from `status.vehicleStatus === "Sold"`)
- "This 2023 Highlander Hybrid Limited has sold." (composed from `vehicleInfo`)
- "Sold on March 24, 2026 at Toyota of Bay Ridge" (from `data.vehicle.soldAt` + `dealer.dealerName`)
- "Search similar to this" button (no purchase flow)
- No dealer info, no test drive slots, no pricing
